plugins.name: fk-po
plugins.description: Product-owner tooling — six skills. The explore → brainstorm → ticket flow: fk-po-explore (read-only feature explainer in product language), fk-po-brainstorm (pre-ticket grilling loop for fuzzy ideas), and fk-po-ticket (full grilled Jira ticket with screenshot attachments). Plus fk-po-bug-video: reproduces a bug on acceptance in a recorded browser and files an annotated Jira Bug. Plus fk-release-notes: drafts EN+NL release-note items from shipped Jira tickets for the PO to review and publish manually. The ticket and brainstorm flows grow CONTEXT.md and docs/adr/ in both repos inline. Plus fk-po-help-video: the PO names a subject, Claude resolves the route from the frontend code and the running app, proposes a storyboard and proves it walks in a browser before any spend, then records a Dutch video with voice-over, subtitles and chapter cards.
